title: PDF Download Click
description: FR-1001's PDF export is only useful if the actual button in the browser fires it correctly — an authenticated fetch, a real PDF blob, and a download, not a dead link.
successCondition: Clicking "Download PDF" on a generated invoice triggers a fetch to GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/pdf with the current bearer token, the response's Content-Type is application/pdf, and the resulting blob is used to programmatically click a generated <a download> link (observable via the download attribute name "invoice-<id>.pdf" set just before the click, or by intercepting the blob URL creation) — the click must not simply open a static href.
hints: This isn't a real <a href> link sitting in the DOM waiting to be clicked — it's a button that fetches, builds a blob URL, and synthesizes the click itself, so a network-level assertion is more reliable than a static href check.
The button is only visible once an invoice has been generated for that shipment.
